title: Apple iOS 28 Development Adds 50% Coding Time
description: Apple is taking a new approach to iOS 28 development, adding Agentic Siri and 50% more coding time. Source: MacRumors Short news summary.
narration: Apple iOS 28 development is getting 50% slower. According to MacRumors, Apple is taking a new approach to developing iOS 28 and macOS 28. The new approach includes adding Agentic Siri to iOS 28. MacRumors also reports the changes cover both iOS and macOS platforms. FourWeekMBA reports the iOS 28 stage now requires 50% more coding time. The extra coding time is linked to the addition of Agentic Siri. Apple says the schedule shift helps engineers manage the new workload. The new development approach also includes updates for macOS 28. The schedule shift is designed to help engineers handle the increased coding demands. Apple is also focusing on macOS 28 improvements.
